_about: Single source of truth for the tailored EverWorker AI SDR deck. Agent 3 overwrites this file, then runs `npm run build:deck-bites && npm run export:pdf-bites`. PROSPECT/cover/research describe the company the deck is FOR (EverWorker's buyer). target/outreach describe a discovered account that fits the prospect's ICP. Highlight punchy phrases by wrapping them in ==double-equals==. This file ships with the Bites/CAVA reference example so a fresh clone builds a complete demo deck.
